title: Reserve and settle decimal credits with idempotent requests
instruction: Complete CreditLedger while preserving its constructor and reserve, commit, cancel APIs. limits must be a non-empty mapping of non-empty account strings to finite positive Decimal values with at most two fractional digits; bool, int, float and strings are invalid. Copy limits defensively. reserve requires an existing account, a positive two-decimal Decimal amount, and a non-empty request_id. Pending and committed reservations both consume the account limit. A new request that would exceed the limit returns False without state change. Repeating an identical request is idempotent and returns its original admission result; reusing a request_id with different account or amount raises ValueError. commit changes an admitted pending request to committed and is idempotent; cancel releases only an admitted pending request and is idempotent. Unknown or rejected request IDs cannot be committed, and rejected retries remain rejected. Validate before mutation and never expose or mutate caller data. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-3 numeric/aggregate lineage with exact decimals, admission replay, state transitions, and atomic limits.
